headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for Atomberg SL1 Pro Bluetooth Smart Lock (Homebridge 2.0 & 1.x ready)
footerDisplay: For troubleshooting and credentials extraction, see project README.

mac.title: Lock MAC Address
mac.description: Bluetooth MAC address of the Atomberg Lock.

masterKey.title: Static Master Key
masterKey.description: 16-character ASCII key extracted from pairing log.

salt.title: Lock Salt
salt.description: 8-character hex salt extracted from pairing log.

configPath.title: Or Path to config.json (Alternative)
configPath.description: Optional: Path to JSON configuration file if you prefer not to enter keys directly above.

adapter.title: Bluetooth Adapter (Optional)
adapter.description: HCI adapter name (e.g. hci0 or hci1).

autoLockDelay.title: Auto-Relock Delay (Seconds)
autoLockDelay.description: Seconds after unlock before HomeKit automatically displays the lock as SECURED (matching hardware 5s clutch).

pythonPath.title: Python 3 Executable Path (Optional)
pythonPath.description: Leave blank to auto-detect (/home/homebridge/venv/bin/python3 or system python3).

enableBattery.title: Expose Battery Service
enableBattery.description: Periodically queries and reports lock battery percentage in Apple Home.
